title: Friendship Theorem OQ-02: Directed and Hypergraph Generalizations
description: Formalizes directed and hypergraph generalizations of the Friendship Theorem (Erdős-Rényi-Sós 1966). Proves: directed friendship property definitions, Longyear-Parsons regularity (n ≡ 3 mod 4), Steiner triple system vertex degree formula, triple count formula n(n-1)/6, and mod 6 necessary condition (n ≡ 1 or 3 mod 6). Spectral characterization axiomatized. 1 axiom. 11 theorems.

meta.author: Lean Genius Research
meta.assumptions: 1 axiom: spectral characterization of directed friendship tournaments.

overview.historicalContext: Erdős-Rényi-Sós (1966) proved the undirected Friendship Theorem. Longyear-Parsons (1972) extended to directed tournaments.
overview.problemStatement: Formalize Steiner triple systems and directed friendship theorem.
overview.proofStrategy: Counting argument: each vertex in (n-1)/2 triples → 2|(n-1); total n(n-1)/6 triples → 6|n(n-1); combined: n ≡ 1 or 3 mod 6.
